lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Hi, Hyunju! I heard you were sick. Are you feeling better now?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Thanks for asking. I feel much better now.
lines.ko: 물어봐 줘서 고마워. 이제 훨씬 나아졌어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Oh, good! I'm so glad to hear that. What happened? Did you go to the doctor?
lines.ko: 다행이다! 정말 기쁘다. 어떻게 된 거야? 병원은 갔어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I went to see a doctor and got a shot.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: A shot! No wonder you got better so fast. How did you catch a cold?
lines.ko: 주사! 그래서 그렇게 빨리 나았구나. 감기는 어쩌다 걸렸어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I went for a walk at night. It was cold.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Oh, the nights are getting really cold these days. You should wear a warm jacket next time! Did you rest at home?
lines.ko: 요즘 밤에 진짜 추워졌어. 다음엔 따뜻한 재킷 꼭 입어! 집에서 쉬었어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I rested at home and slept a lot. It was very helpful.
lines.ko: 응, 집에서 쉬고 잠을 많이 잤어. 그게 많이 도움이 됐어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: That's good. Sleep is the best medicine! Hey, when you're fully better, let's go to the Do Ho Suh exhibition together! When are you free?
lines.ko: 잘했어. 잠이 최고의 약이지! 있잖아, 다 나으면 서도호 전시회 같이 가자! 언제 시간 돼?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Thank you, but I need to take care of myself for a while. When I'm fully recovered, I'll get in touch with you.
lines.ko: 고마워. 그런데 당분간은 몸조리를 해야 할 것 같아. 완전히 나으면 연락할게.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Of course! Your health comes first. Take care, and call me when you're ready. Bye!
lines.ko: 당연하지! 건강이 먼저야. 몸조리 잘하고, 괜찮아지면 전화해. 안녕!

I went to see a doctor and got a shot.

I need to rest for a while.
